# Criminal Records
Every character in the round has a record, kept in one database shared by every records computer and tablet.
## Accessing Records - Use the [bold]criminal records computer[/bold] at your station, or the [bold]mobile criminal records tablet[/bold] in the field. - The tablet needs Marshal, colony administration, colony command or brig access.
## Looking People Up - Search for someone by name, or look them up by their fingerprints or DNA. - The [textlink="forensic scanner" link="CMUGuideForensics"] only reports a match for people who are in the records.
## Statuses - [bold]Wanted[/bold]: to be arrested. Give a reason. - [bold]Suspect[/bold]: under suspicion. Give a reason. - [bold]Detained[/bold]: in custody. - [bold]Paroled[/bold]: released on conditions. - [bold]Discharged[/bold]: released. - [bold]Hostile[/bold]: a threat to the colony. - [bold]Deceased[/bold]: dead.
Every status change is announced on the CMB channel, naming the officer who made it.
## Crime History Add each charge to the person's history as it's made, so the next officer to look them up knows what they've done.
